answer: Consider stake-backed identity: before an agent may vote it locks a slashable bond, and peers attest that one bond secures one credential. A Sybil farmer must fund every fake wallet separately, so the cost climbs with each new identity instead of being paid once, and double-signing burns the bond. Sending a false whisper down a ridge of fresh wallets becomes a losing trade, since the payoff is a walnut while the forfeited stake is a fortune.
